test_cases.title: Verify adding committee member from existing users list
test_cases.precondition: User is logged in with appropriate permissions and navigated to Committee Members page
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Add Member' button
2. Verify 'Add Committee Member' modal opens
3. Select 'Existing User' tab
4. Click on a user from the list (e.g., Alex Johnson)
5. Select a job role from 'Select a job role...' dropdown
6. Click 'Add Member' button
test_cases.expected_result: Committee member is successfully added, modal closes, success message 'Committee Member successfully added' appears, user card displays in the members grid with correct name, role, and email

test_cases.title: Verify making a member committee chair
test_cases.precondition: At least 2 committee members exist in the system
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Committee Members page
2. Locate a member card (not currently chair)
3. Click 'Make Chair' button on the member card
4. Verify 'Change Committee Chair' confirmation modal appears
5. Review the new chair name displayed in modal
6. Click 'Confirm' button
test_cases.expected_result: Chair role is successfully transferred, confirmation modal closes, previous chair loses chair designation, new member is designated as chair with 'Chair' label visible on their card

test_cases.title: Verify deleting a committee member
test_cases.precondition: At least one non-chair committee member exists
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Committee Members page
2. Locate a member card
3. Click the delete icon (trash icon) on the member card
4. Verify delete confirmation prompt appears
5. Confirm deletion
test_cases.expected_result: Member is removed from the committee, member card disappears from grid, member count decreases by 1, success message appears

test_cases.title: Verify editing committee member information
test_cases.precondition: At least one committee member exists
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Committee Members page
2. Locate a member card
3. Click the edit icon (pencil icon) on the member card
4. Modify member details (e.g., job role)
5. Save changes
test_cases.expected_result: Member information is updated successfully, updated details display on member card, success message appears

test_cases.title: Verify manual entry of new committee member
test_cases.precondition: User is logged in with appropriate permissions
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Add Member' button
2. Select 'Manual Entry' tab in the modal
3. Enter member details manually (name, email, job role)
4. Click 'Save & Add More' or 'Add Member' button
test_cases.expected_result: New member is created and added to committee, member card appears in grid with entered information, appropriate success message displays

test_cases.title: Verify search functionality for existing users in add member modal
test_cases.precondition: Multiple existing users are available in the system
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Add Member' button
2. In 'Existing User' tab, locate the search field
3. Enter a user's name or email (e.g., 'Maria')
4. Observe the filtered results
test_cases.expected_result: User list filters in real-time showing only matching users, search is case-insensitive, partial matches are displayed

test_cases.title: Verify member count display updates correctly
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page is accessible
test_cases.steps:
1. Note the current member count displayed (e.g., 'Members 8')
2. Add a new member
3. Verify count increases to 9
4. Delete a member
5. Verify count decreases to 8
test_cases.expected_result: Member count accurately reflects the total number of committee members and updates in real-time after add/delete operations

test_cases.title: Verify committee chair invitation email is sent
test_cases.precondition: Email system is configured, at least one member exists
test_cases.steps:
1. Make a member committee chair
2. Confirm the action
3. Check the member's email inbox for invitation
test_cases.expected_result: Committee Chair Invitation Update email is sent to the new chair with correct details, invitation includes organization name, role description, and accept invite button

test_cases.title: Verify committee member invitation email is sent
test_cases.precondition: Email system is configured
test_cases.steps:
1. Add a new committee member
2. Complete the addition process
3. Check the member's email inbox
test_cases.expected_result: Committee Invitation email is sent to new member with correct details, email includes organization info, role description, and accept invite button

test_cases.title: Verify grid/list view toggle functionality
test_cases.precondition: At least one committee member exists
test_cases.steps:
1. Locate the view toggle buttons (grid/list icons) in the search bar area
2. Click the list view icon
3. Verify members display in list format
4. Click the grid view icon
5. Verify members display in card grid format
test_cases.expected_result: View toggles between grid and list layouts smoothly, all member information remains visible in both views, selected view state is visually indicated

test_cases.title: Verify adding member without selecting job role (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: User is on Add Committee Member modal with Existing User tab
test_cases.steps:
1. Select a user from the existing users list
2. Do NOT select any job role
3. Click 'Add Member' button
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error appears indicating job role is required, member is not added, 'Add Member' button may be disabled or error message displays

test_cases.title: Verify adding duplicate committee member (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: At least one committee member already exists (e.g., Alex Johnson)
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Add Member' button
2. Select the same user who is already a committee member
3. Select a job role
4. Click 'Add Member' button
test_cases.expected_result: Error message appears indicating user is already a committee member, duplicate member is not added to the committee

test_cases.title: Verify deleting the only committee chair (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: Only one committee chair exists in the system
test_cases.steps:
1. Locate the current committee chair's card
2. Click the delete icon
3. Attempt to confirm deletion
test_cases.expected_result: Error or warning message appears preventing deletion, message indicates that at least one chair must exist, or prompts user to assign new chair before deletion

test_cases.title: Verify canceling add member operation (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open
test_cases.steps:
1. Select a user from the list
2. Select a job role
3. Click 'Cancel' button
test_cases.expected_result: Modal closes without adding the member, no changes are made to the committee, member count remains unchanged

test_cases.title: Verify canceling change chair operation (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: Change Committee Chair modal is open
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Make Chair' on a member
2. Confirmation modal appears
3. Click 'Cancel' button
test_cases.expected_result: Modal closes without changing chair, current chair designation remains unchanged, no chair transfer occurs

test_cases.title: Verify manual entry with invalid email format (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open on Manual Entry tab
test_cases.steps:
1. Enter member name
2. Enter invalid email format (e.g., 'notanemail', 'test@', '@example.com')
3. Select job role
4. Attempt to save
test_cases.expected_result: Email validation error appears, member is not added, error message indicates proper email format required

test_cases.title: Verify manual entry with empty required fields (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open on Manual Entry tab
test_cases.steps:
1. Leave name field empty
2. Enter email
3. Select job role
4. Attempt to save
test_cases.expected_result: Validation error appears indicating required fields, member is not added, all required fields are highlighted

test_cases.title: Verify search with no matching results (Negative)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open on Existing User tab
test_cases.steps:
1. Enter a search term that matches no users (e.g., 'ZZZZZ12345')
2. Observe the results list
test_cases.expected_result: No results message is displayed, 'Add Member' button is disabled or shows appropriate state, user can clear search to see all users again

test_cases.title: Verify adding maximum number of committee members (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: System has a maximum limit for committee members (if applicable)
test_cases.steps:
1. Add members until reaching the maximum limit
2. Attempt to add one more member
test_cases.expected_result: System prevents adding beyond maximum limit, appropriate message displays indicating limit reached, 'Add Member' button may be disabled

test_cases.title: Verify member name with special characters (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open on Manual Entry tab
test_cases.steps:
1. Enter name with special characters (e.g., 'O'Brien', 'José García', 'Anne-Marie')
2. Enter valid email
3. Select job role
4. Save
test_cases.expected_result: Member is added successfully, special characters are properly displayed on member card, no encoding issues occur

test_cases.title: Verify very long member name display (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open on Manual Entry tab
test_cases.steps:
1. Enter an extremely long name (e.g., 50+ characters)
2. Enter valid email
3. Select job role
4. Add member
5. Observe the member card display
test_cases.expected_result: Long name is truncated with ellipsis or wraps appropriately, card layout remains intact, full name is visible on hover or in tooltip

test_cases.title: Verify very long email address (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open on Manual Entry tab
test_cases.steps:
1. Enter valid name
2. Enter very long but valid email (e.g., 'verylongemailaddressname@verylongdomainname.com')
3. Select job role
4. Add member
5. Observe display on member card
test_cases.expected_result: Email is accepted and member is added, email display is truncated with ellipsis on card, full email visible on hover or in expanded view

test_cases.title: Verify adding all available users as members (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: Limited number of users exist in the system
test_cases.steps:
1. Add all existing users as committee members
2. Open Add Member modal
3. Check Existing User tab
test_cases.expected_result: Only users who are not already members are displayed, or appropriate message indicates all users are already members, system handles empty user list gracefully

test_cases.title: Verify rapid successive chair changes (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: Multiple committee members exist
test_cases.steps:
1. Make Member A chair
2. Immediately make Member B chair
3. Immediately make Member C chair
4. Verify final state
test_cases.expected_result: System processes all chair changes correctly in sequence, only the last member (C) is designated as chair, no race conditions or duplicate chairs occur

test_cases.title: Verify custom job role entry with 'Others' checkbox (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open
test_cases.steps:
1. Select a user
2. Check 'Others' checkbox in job role
3. Enter custom job role text
4. Add member
test_cases.expected_result: Custom job role is accepted and saved, custom role displays on member card, system stores and retrieves custom role correctly

test_cases.title: Verify search with case sensitivity (Edge)
test_cases.precondition: Committee members page with search functionality
test_cases.steps:
1. Enter search term in lowercase (e.g., 'alex')
2. Observe results
3. Clear search
4. Enter same term in uppercase (e.g., 'ALEX')
5. Observe results
test_cases.expected_result: Search is case-insensitive, both searches return the same results (Alex Johnson), user experience is consistent

test_cases.title: Verify empty state display and messaging (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: No committee members exist in the system
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Committee Members page
2. Observe the empty state
test_cases.expected_result: Empty state displays folder icon, 'No Results found' message, helpful text explaining to add members, 'Add First Member' button is prominently displayed, overall design is clean and user-friendly

test_cases.title: Verify modal overlay and focus behavior (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page is accessible
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Add Member' button
2. Observe modal appearance
3. Try clicking outside the modal
4. Press ESC key
test_cases.expected_result: Modal appears with proper overlay dimming background, clicking outside modal closes it (or does not if modal is strict), ESC key closes modal, focus is trapped within modal while open

test_cases.title: Verify member card visual design consistency (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Multiple committee members exist
test_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to Committee Members page in grid view
2. Observe all member cards
3. Verify card sizing, spacing, alignment
4. Check icon placement and colors
test_cases.expected_result: All cards have consistent width and height, spacing between cards is uniform, 'Chair' label is visually distinct on chair's card, icons (delete, edit, Make Chair) are consistently positioned, hover states are smooth and visible

test_cases.title: Verify success notification appearance and auto-dismiss (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page is accessible
test_cases.steps:
1. Add a new committee member
2. Observe the success notification
3. Wait to see if it auto-dismisses
4. Note the notification positioning and styling
test_cases.expected_result: Success notification 'Committee Member successfully added' appears at bottom-left in green background, notification includes close icon (X), notification auto-dismisses after 3-5 seconds, message is clearly readable

test_cases.title: Verify responsive design on different screen sizes (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page is accessible
test_cases.steps:
1. View page on desktop (1920x1080)
2. Resize to tablet size (768px width)
3. Resize to mobile size (375px width)
4. Observe layout adjustments
test_cases.expected_result: Grid adjusts number of columns based on screen size, member cards remain readable and functional, buttons and controls remain accessible, no horizontal scrolling occurs, navigation adapts appropriately

test_cases.title: Verify button states and hover effects (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page is accessible with members
test_cases.steps:
1. Hover over 'Add Member' button
2. Hover over 'Make Chair' button
3. Hover over delete icon
4. Hover over edit icon
5. Observe disabled button state (if applicable)
test_cases.expected_result: All buttons show clear hover states with color change or effect, cursor changes to pointer on hover, disabled buttons are visually distinct with reduced opacity, button colors align with action severity (delete is red/destructive color)

test_cases.title: Verify tab switching animation in Add Member modal (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Add Committee Member modal is open
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Manual Entry' tab
2. Observe transition
3. Click 'Existing User' tab
4. Observe transition
test_cases.expected_result: Tab switch is smooth without jarring transitions, active tab is clearly indicated with visual styling, content loads instantly without flicker, tab underline or highlight animates smoothly

test_cases.title: Verify email template branding and formatting (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Access to email invitation preview or sent emails
test_cases.steps:
1. Trigger committee invitation email
2. Open the email in email client
3. Verify AQUILA branding
4. Check formatting and readability
5. Test 'Accept Invite' button
test_cases.expected_result: Email displays AQUILA logo correctly, formatting is consistent across email clients, 'Accept Invite' button is prominent and clickable, all text is readable with proper spacing, support contact information is clearly visible

test_cases.title: Verify icon clarity and consistency (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page with members
test_cases.steps:
1. Identify all icons on the page (delete, edit, search, view toggle, etc.)
2. Check icon size consistency
3. Verify icon meaning is clear
4. Check color consistency
test_cases.expected_result: All icons are consistently sized, icon meanings are intuitive (trash for delete, pencil for edit), destructive actions (delete) use red/warning color, icons are clearly visible against background, tooltips appear on hover for clarity

test_cases.title: Verify confirmation modal design and clarity (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page with members
test_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Make Chair' on a member
2. Observe the confirmation modal design
3. Check text clarity and button placement
4. Verify visual hierarchy
test_cases.expected_result: Modal title 'Change Committee Chair' is clear and prominent, warning message is readable and explains consequences, new chair name is highlighted, 'Confirm' button is visually distinct from 'Cancel', star icon reinforces the chair concept

test_cases.title: Verify keyboard navigation accessibility (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page is accessible
test_cases.steps:
1. Use Tab key to navigate through page elements
2. Use Enter/Space to activate buttons
3. Navigate through Add Member modal using keyboard
4. Try navigating member cards
test_cases.expected_result: All interactive elements are keyboard accessible, focus indicator is clearly visible, tab order is logical (top to bottom, left to right), modal can be closed with ESC key, dropdown can be operated with arrow keys

test_cases.title: Verify page header and navigation consistency (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Committee Members page is accessible
test_cases.steps:
1. Observe page header 'Committee Members'
2. Check subtitle/description text
3. Verify alignment with sidebar navigation
4. Check time and user info display in top header
test_cases.expected_result: Page title is clear and properly sized, subtitle 'Manage your information security committee members and designate leadership roles' is visible and helpful, active menu item in sidebar is highlighted, top header shows correct time, user name, and DPO designation

test_cases.title: Verify loading states and skeleton screens (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Ability to simulate slow network connection
test_cases.steps:
1. Clear cache or simulate slow network
2. Navigate to Committee Members page
3. Observe loading behavior
4. Add a member and observe submission loading state
test_cases.expected_result: Loading state displays skeleton screens or spinner, user cannot interact with page during loading, button shows loading indicator during submission, no content flash or layout shift occurs

test_cases.title: Verify error state messaging and design (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Ability to trigger validation errors
test_cases.steps:
1. Attempt to add member without required fields
2. Observe error messages
3. Check error message positioning
4. Verify error styling (color, icons)
test_cases.expected_result: Error messages are clearly visible in red or warning color, messages appear near the relevant field, error icon or indicator is present, error text is specific and actionable (not generic), form fields with errors are highlighted

test_cases.title: Verify color contrast for accessibility (UI/UX)
test_cases.precondition: Access to color contrast checking tool
test_cases.steps:
1. Use accessibility tool (e.g., WAVE, axe DevTools)
2. Check contrast ratios for text on buttons
3. Check contrast for member card text
4. Verify icon contrast against backgrounds
test_cases.expected_result: All text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text), button text is clearly readable, member information on cards has sufficient contrast, state indicators (Chair label) are distinguishable
